subtitle: Three.js property board game — every price real, every source open
benchmark: Catan Universe (primary) / THE GAME OF LIFE 2 (secondary)

spend.note: No numeric ceiling was set by the brief. The run ended on the blind win, not on a ceiling.

headline: Blind win confirmed twice with the A/B positions flipped: desktop 2-1, mobile 3-0 unanimous, against real Catan Universe screenshots. Every gate passes. One thing is outstanding and it is not mine: the Vercel deploy.

pieces.name: Fact base — 22 streets, real HMLR figures
pieces.note: 22/22 sourced. Median price paid or UK HPI, per street, with transaction IDs.

pieces.name: Integrity gate — value + banned-words
pieces.note: Money provenance + load-time absence check + banned-word sweep + build-time source scanner.

pieces.name: 3D board, camera, lighting
pieces.note: Blind physicality judge: ours 74, benchmark 65. Praised the slab's lit bevel and the prop whose shadow matches the board's.

pieces.name: Dice + token movement feel
pieces.note: Real 3D dice with debossed pips and tight contact shadows, resting on the board.

pieces.name: Mobile touch + responsive layout
pieces.note: Blind mobile panel 3-0 unanimous: ours 78/82/79, benchmark 44/33/64.

pieces.name: HUD, player panels, turn state
pieces.note: Blind interface judge: ours 84, benchmark 58. Five redundant active-turn cues against their one.

pieces.name: Property data panel — FT standards
pieces.note: Still sent back by the FT desk, 71 against 82. The one piece that never won.

pieces.name: Event cards + modals
pieces.note: A card now opens every round — a critic played 15 rounds and never saw one.

pieces.name: First-run, onboarding, footer
pieces.note: Landscape fixed: sheets scroll 2,797px in a 331px viewport; round counter renders.

pieces.name: Game economy — stakes
pieces.note: You now win on annual rent roll, not net worth. Site assembly doubles a completed group. The levy fires every lap. Decisiveness went from a 5% margin to 39%.

pieces.name: Restart soft-lock
pieces.note: Generation guard: an in-flight turn abandons itself when superseded. Survives 5 mid-animation restarts, zero errors.

log.text: HM Land Registry Price Paid + UK HPI endpoints verified live.
Real screenshots of Catan Universe and THE GAME OF LIFE 2 downloaded for blind comparison.
22/22 streets fetched from HMLR. 2026 transactions present.
Fact base written: data/landlord-facts.json.
Round 0 research fan-out running: events, licence, FT standards, benchmark teardown, touch, rules.
Event cards: 21 sourced, 14 unverifiable claims rejected — including the widely-misreported 'EPC C by 2027' deadlines.
Integrity gate written: money carries provenance; anything rendered without a chain to the facts file halts the game.
Adversarial fact-check: 21/21 facts confirmed, 7 card wordings corrected for overstating their source.
Four module builders launched: 3D scene, HUD, FT data panel, stylesheet.
v1 integrated and running. Build clean, no console errors.
Integrity gate attacked with six injections — untraced value, untagged value, banned word, trade dress, bogus WebGL label, undeclared numeral. All six caught.
Blind sets built at benchmark-matched dimensions so only craft differs.
Critics: lost 41-78 mobile, 67-78 desktop, 66-92 on FT data standards. Gaps named and specific.
Play critic: 'a beautiful, honest, well-guarded shell around a game that never makes you care.' Six hard blockers found.
Economy rebuilt: win on rent roll, site assembly doubles a group, land value levy every lap. 300-game sim: margin 5% to 39%.
Restart wired properly — three separate controls were dead. A Gazette card now opens every round.
Three fixers dispatched against the named gaps.
Fixers hit a session limit mid-edit and left scene.js broken. Repaired by hand: a changed function signature had not reached its call site.
Gate found a real disagreement: £4,050,000 renders as £4.0m under one rounding and £4.1mn under another. Replaced string matching with rounding-band matching — stricter, not looser.
Gate re-verified by attack: 8 injections, all caught, including a fabricated compact value whose band contains no real figure.
Five 'undefined month' strings removed. Zero undefined or NaN anywhere in the panels.
Relaunched Round 3 — the session limit had already lifted, so the wait was wasted time.
Vercel diagnosed: the connector is authorised for teddy-james-projects (which cannot create projects) and not for tercero-analytics at all.
Deploy payload measured at 479KB — too large to pass through a tool call. Switched to a one-command CLI deploy.
Round 3 landed: 3 agents, 776k tokens. Build clean, gates pass, no console errors.
Blind critics judging the rematch at benchmark-matched dimensions.
Threw out a critic round: args arrived as a string so it silently judged four-hour-old screenshots. Now fails loudly instead of guessing.
Two critics gave opposite verdicts on identical images. Replaced the single judge with a three-lens panel decided by majority.
BLIND WIN: desktop 2-1, mobile 3-0 unanimous, against real Catan Universe screenshots at matched dimensions.
Play critic confirmed the economy fix: 'nothing is at stake is emphatically NO LONGER TRUE, proven over two complete games'.
Round 4 fixing the last two losses: landscape sheets, and a chart whose mark contradicts its own headline.
Blind win held with positions flipped — desktop 2-1, mobile 3-0 unanimous.
Play critic found a hard crash on restart and proved gearing was strictly dominant. Both fixed.
Score is now NET rent roll after debt service. Simulation: mixed policy beats always-gear 71% and always-outright 58% — a real decision exists.
Full suite green: build gate, runtime gate under attack, 400-game engine sim, blockers, landscape, restart stress.
